decisions.decision: Nothing further is expected from the client. The shipping and warranty placeholders were removed; the page states only what is sourced (nationwide transportation available; warranty options available) and routes the rest to the contact page.

decisions.what: Skeleton follows the live site's sections; Financing and About are tiles only; display face Zilla Slab. The tabs are opened, trimmed, never extended.
